prose: Adult specimens measure up to twelve centimeters and possess a mineralized, slate-grey exoskeleton reinforced with bio-sequestered lead-210. A steel-toed work boot stomping upon the carapace produces a metallic clink without crushing the insect.

Attracted by electromagnetic 60 Hz hum, a colony of eight thousand insects chewed through twenty meters of polyvinyl chloride wire insulation. The resulting phase-to-phase arc flash incinerated four hundred roaches and killed lighting across Level 2.

Nymphs and adults deposit sticky fecal pheromone trails that emit a steady yellow-green luminescence. Looking into the unlit ventilation plenum reveals an intricate glowing road network of foraging paths branching across the sheet metal.

Small, flattened insects that emerge at 03:00 to feed on human hair, fingernails, and dry epidermal flakes from sleeping dwellers. Five dwellers in Bunk Row 4 woke with clipped eyelashes and chewed cuticles, prompting frantic blowtorch sterilization sweeps.

During the autumn mating flight, thousands of males scrape their modified hind legs against their abdomen plates, creating a piercing 14,500 Hz acoustic screech that reverberates through structural elevator rails. Sentry guards reported nausea and temporary tinnitus.

Gut microbiome of this colony contains specialized anaerobic fungi capable of digesting cellulose, casein glue, and drafting linen. The swarm consumed seventy pre-war bunker blueprints and ten years of hand-written ration ledger books in twenty days.

When disturbed by maintenance probes, the insect rotates its abdominal tip and discharges an explosive jet of boiling 98°C benzoquinone and hydrogen peroxide. A plumber suffered second-degree facial burns and permanent corneal clouding from a direct discharge.

Baited with spoiled cabbage mash and warm beer condensate, the automated iron funnel traps yield forty-five kilograms of live roaches weekly. The insects are autoclaved at 120°C, dried on steam coils, and milled into grey 'Tier-3 Survival Flour' providing 62% digestible crude protein.
